headline: A 2011 executive order created the White House Rural Council, a new group within the White House focused on rural America.
what_it_does: This order set up a council in the White House to work on issues facing rural areas. Based on the title alone, it appears to organize federal efforts related to rural communities. No summary was provided, so details about the council's members, duties, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies involved in rural issues would likely take part in or coordinate through the new council.

who_it_affects.group: People who live in rural areas
who_it_affects.how: The council's work is aimed at rural communities, though the order's direct effects on residents are not described in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on June 9, 2011, as is typical for executive orders; no effective date was provided.
